mentions.name: Heathkit IO-12 oscilloscope restoration
mentions.description: A hobbyist restoration of a vintage Heathkit IO-12 oscilloscope, bought working at a thrift store for $75, that replaces aged components that are physically breaking down so the lightly used unit can keep running for decades; the original owner's assembly date and callsign were found inside, and the restoration lands 58 years to the day after the initial build.
mentions.problem: The 58-year-old oscilloscope's aged components are physically breaking down and need replacement.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm finally fulfilling a childhood dream of restoring a Heathkit oscilloscope. I managed to nab a functioning IO-12 at the thrift store for $75!

evidence.value: I'm finally fulfilling a childhood dream of restoring a Heathkit oscilloscope. I managed to nab a functioning IO-12 at the thrift store for $75!
